title: German Beer Bread
description: A simple German bread recipe made with a focus on beer to bring out the yeast flavor.

ingredients.name: yeasty beer
ingredients.notes: any German beer with a high yeast content

ingredients.name: ham
ingredients.notes: optional, diced or chopped, for added flavor

instructions: Mix the beer with the flour in a large bowl.
Add the salt and mix until combined.
If using ham, fold it in at this stage.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Shape the dough into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
